save.text: Sam absent; Scanlan to be run by Keyleth and Percy; Pike still in New York; Patrick Rothfuss (Kerrek) joins via Skype.
Lootcrate sponsorship: January theme 'origins'; order cutoff 9 PM tonight; URL lootcrate.com/criticalrole; promo code 'criticalrole' for 10% off first month.
Blue Microphones provided new gear; Matt uses Blue mics; site bluemic.com.
New store item: socks with 'How do you want to do this?' and logo; potential future 'Sox Machina'; dice returning soon (this or next month); pins and bracelets limited stock.
Anime Milwaukee attendance Feb 17–19: guests Matt, Marisha, Travis, Laura; Critical Role panel and signings planned.
Patrick Rothfuss in Wisconsin may meet them during Anime Milwaukee dates; dinner suggested.

Recap: Thordak slain; Raishan escaped with Thordak’s corpse and two eggs via teleport; Vox Machina rested in Whitestone and plan to pursue Raishan to a southern Lucidian Ocean island (Thordak’s former lair, once Opash’s).
Level-ups confirmed: Scanlan, Percy, Pike leveled; party has full rest and spells; Pike’s 8th-level spell not locked (cleric access to all cleric spells).

Item/attunement shuffle: Vax asks Vex to return his Boots (given to Keyleth briefly, then to Vax); Dragon-slaying sword passed to Grog; Dwarven Thrower identified but requires dwarf attunement (Grog cannot).
Dwarven Thrower can be attuned by Grog if Belt of Dwarvenkind is attuned; losing belt drops hammer attunement. Grog plans to attune Thrower instead of Blood Axe (range 20/60; d8 damage).

Party rested; levels as before. Attunements: Vax sets Deathwalker’s Ward to necrotic; Boots of Elvenkind given to Pike (no attunement) replacing her Sprinter’s Boots (which require attunement, per Matt pending card check).

Pursuit of Raishan continues; stealth approach discussed. Vex returns Vax’s Boots; Pike takes Boots of Elvenkind; swapping Pike’s boots mid-mission is slow. Kerrek has 2 attunement slots free and can take Dancing Sword if needed; Grog currently holds it.

Dancing Sword cursed: when Grog presented it, curse triggered; sword became inert. Grog suffers permanent -2 to all saving throws (Matt corrected prior session misread; from Deck of Many Things), removable only by divine-level intervention.

Pursuit of Raishan continues; stealth approach discussed. Vex returned Vax’s Boots; Pike has Boots of Elvenkind; swapping Pike’s boots mid-mission is slow. Kerrek has 2 attunement slots free; Grog no longer has a functional Dancing Sword (now inert).

Party rested; levels as before. Attunements: Vax set Deathwalker’s Ward to necrotic; Boots of Elvenkind to Pike. Note: Pike may attempt Greater Restoration on Grog’s curse, but Matt indicated only divine-level removal; outcome pending.
Pike cast 5th-level Greater Restoration on Grog; curse/headache unchanged. Confirms only divine-level removal works.
Kerrek loaned Vax’s Ring of Invisibility and Cloak of Displacement for Raishan fight; ring returns after. Ring ends on remove/attack/cast or bonus action to end.
Heroes’ Feast cast by Pike using diamond from hoard: party (incl. Trinket, Kerrek, Allura, Kima) immune to fear/poison, Wis save advantage, +15 max HP.
Heroes’ Feast included Kima and Allura; both arrived early enough to eat; party has feast benefits.
Allura can cast Teleport (7th level); Keyleth will use Transport via Plants (6th) to travel instead.
Team plans to avoid scrying Opash’s cave before leaving to keep surprise; scrying sensor is visible to See Invisibility.
Keyleth used Transport via Plants via the Sun Tree to a tree near Opash’s island; Allura accompanied, hood up.
Party avoided scrying the cave directly; second scry with Allura targeted Island of Viscan to locate nearby trees.
Kima accepted Boots of Elvenkind from Vex before departure; she equipped them despite not matching.
Trees on Opash’s island are near-petrified, long-dead for hundreds of years; not a recent event. Keyleth confirmed via nature check.
Keyleth used Transport via Plants via the Sun Tree to a tree near Opash’s island; Allura accompanied, hood up. Stealth aided by Pass Without Trace; Allura and Kima rolled well (boots helped Kima).
Kima accepted and is wearing Boots of Elvenkind from Vex; boots negated her stealth disadvantage during approach.
Kima wearing Vex’s Boots of Elvenkind; negated her stealth disadvantage during approach.
Patches of unstable ground near Opash’s mountain identified; Vex spotted subtle darker/damp sand and warned Vax; multiple patches grow denser toward the mountain; avoid 10–15 ft ovals.

Keyleth nature check: trees long-dead for hundreds of years; nearer mountain many reduced to ash/dust; ground patches are “hollow earth” from past magical release causing unstable sinkhole-like ground.
Mountain ~600 ft tall, large rocky mound; at base a boulder (20–30 ft wide) jammed into the entrance, surface peppered with claw-punched holes.
Hole marks identified as repeated claw intrusions by a very large dragon; boulder has been placed/removed many times over years.
Plan debate: don’t move whole boulder; Keyleth to Stone Shape at seam to make a passable gap; avoid giving dragon easy exit.
Keyleth nature check: trees long-dead; nearer mountain many reduced to ash/dust; ground patches are hollow/unstable from past magical release causing sinkhole risk.
Opash’s mountain ~600 ft; entrance at base blocked by 20–30 ft boulder with many claw-punched holes.
Claw holes from very large dragon; boulder has been moved repeatedly over years.
Plan: avoid moving whole boulder; Keyleth to Stone Shape at seam to make a passable gap, keeping dragon exit restricted.

Scry/awareness: Vex used Primeval Awareness; detects three dragon life forces within 1 mile, below/in mountain—likely Thordak’s mate + two eggs alive; Patrick’s Divine Sense found no celestial/fiend/undead within 60 ft of boulder.
Keyleth Stone Shape only opened a small crack; wall/boulder thicker than 5 ft. She spent a 4th-level slot and pierced enough to see into tunnel.
Oracle Arrow shot through crack: 100 ft in, tunnel curves left and descends; heavy undisturbed dust, no tracks or light; arrow now lodged there for vision.
Area inside entrance: long, silent, pitch-black tunnel with untouched dust; small arm-width gap currently. Noise may echo; Raishan likely has good hearing.
Boulder has large dragon-sized fingerholds; appears jammed in place by something grabbing and shoving it; no switch found (Grog inv 17).
Plan debate: Option A spend another Stone Shape to carve removable chunk; Matt confirms it would work. Option B use lever through crack to shift boulder; concern about noise and damaging weapons.
Kima asked to use Holy Avenger as lever; she agrees only if not damaged: "You ding it, you pay." Party considering lever physics vs spell slots.
Party levered boulder using Kima’s Holy Avenger with Pike aiding Grog; STR 23 succeeded to shift rock ~1.5 ft for passage; Kima retrieved sword after entry.
Two Immovable Rods wedged into claw holes to brace boulder; holding for now though slowly moving; later appears stationary; plan to retrieve rods on exit.
Inside tunnel: 15 ft wide, 12 ft tall; heavy dust, smell of rot/stagnant water; carved passage, no airflow; scattered charred bone fragments along floor.
Group stealthing down curving, mildly descending tunnel; stealth results: Vex 30, Vax 35, Percy 34, Keyleth 30, Grog 30, Pike 25, Scanlan 18, Kerrek 29.
Bone fragments: charring is years old or longer; bones dusty/untouched recently; supports lair use long ago, not recent activity.
Pike cast Death Ward (4th-level) on Vex; lasts 8 hours; triggers to 1 HP at 0.
Vax’s flame-dagger sheds candle-level light; with it he can see ~60 ft clearly; without it he can see poorly to ~15 ft in darkness.
Tunnel decor: recurring alcove shelves every ~20 ft with long-burned candles, skull, small books, wooden box (untrapped per Vax 22), and a mummified raccoon-like creature.
Party minimized light: Vax was asked to douse but kept dagger for visibility; party links arms to move stealthy in dark; continuing cautious trap checks (investigation 18, nothing found).
Kerrek’s Divine Sense now detects an undead presence to the party’s left on a wall shelf; not extremely powerful; likely the skull/candles alcove.
Alcove shelf to left holds two mostly melted candles and a human skull with slight soot/singeing; Grog retrieved skull and handed it to Kerrek.
Vax couldn’t read book titles (speaks Common, Elvish, Abyssal); titles in unknown language.
Kerrek confirmed skull is the undead source; inert when handled; he bagged it in burlap and set it back on the shelf facing the wall.
Marching order: Twins front; then Grog & Kerrek; then Keyleth & Percy; then Ash & Scanlan; rear: Kima & Allura with Trinket.

Chamber ahead: hexagonal room ending in a large iron door; central dark green marble pillar with bolted rough iron bowl on top; right shelf holds a large leather-bound tome and a cold iron brazier with dried tinder; chamber ~25 ft tall.
Hex room entry is open; the large iron door blocks the far side. No visible ceiling slots, levers, panels, or mechanisms; smooth seams; ancient stone with minor cave-ins.
Central iron bowl on pillar has long-dried dark burgundy residue; tastes iron-like—identified as old blood. Likely blood-activated mechanism.
Large leather-bound tome on right shelf has no cover/spine text; very old, thick leather possibly hide or flesh; Grog inspected without picking up.
Book on shelf fell to floor when nudged; anyone trying to read finds text shrinks/obscures, unreadable; brighter light makes pages go nearly blank with tiny dots.
Kerrek’s warhammer manifests a radiant head when activated, brightening room; Allura present; suggestion made to extinguish lights so darkvision/low-light might read book.
Lighting the cold iron brazier detonated hidden flammables; explosion dealt 32 fire to Keyleth and Kerrek (failed), 16 to others nearby; Allura saved; brazier destroyed; book burned entirely.
Blood-bowl likely mechanism: basilisk blood poured did nothing; Vex then cut her hand to add her own blood.
Hex room: entry open; far large iron door still closed after brazier explosion; no visible mechanisms; ancient stone, smooth seams.
Vex’s blood in iron bowl activated mechanism: basilisk blood pushed aside, bowl glowed, room shook, iron door lifted open; Vex took 1 damage.

Pike cast Holy Aura on party: 30-ft radius, grants allies advantage on saves; enemies have disadvantage on attacks; fiends/undead making melee must CON save or be blinded; emits 5-ft light on each ally.
After door opened, four flame-wreathed skulls (two from each hallway) approached, cackling; combat began with initiatives: Scanlan 22 (nat20), Keyleth 22 (nat20), Vax 21, Percy 17, Vex 16, Grog 14.
Initiative ordering clarified: Scanlan and Vax act first; Pike rolled 9; Kerrek rolled 1; Kima near bottom with Kerrek.
Scanlan cast Invisibility (2nd level per table correction) and backed to northern wall; held no further action.
Vax flew 10 ft up to opposite wall and hit a flameskull twice (Whisper + venom dagger) for 29 total; skull damaged but aloft.
Four flameskulls each cast Fireball focusing center; everyone except invisible Scanlan targeted; DC 13 Dex saves with advantage.

Fireball results: Vax evaded all (0 dmg); Percy, Vex, Keyleth, Kerrek saved all (56 fire each); Pike saved two (88 halved to 44 via fire resist); Grog failed two, saved two (88 fire); Trinket saved one and was in necklace.
Keyleth repositioned to southeast corner before flameskulls’ volley.
Percy (Animus) killed two flameskulls this round: first with 27+2 psychic; second with two follow-ups (22+6 psychic, then 20+4 psychic). He reloaded and took a perch on the wall.

Kerrek’s Aura of Protection (+3 to saves) confirmed; retroactively changed results: Pike reduced prior fire damage by 11; Grog’s two failed Fireball saves became successes—total Fireball damage to Grog is 56, not 88. Trinket still failed three saves even with +3.
